notes.title: 0.20.0 - Vibes
notes.content:
[h1]Hey everyone![/h1]

In this patch we have worked on improving general performance, and also at the same time give players a more Arena vibe with updated audience platforms.  
Gameplay flow has also been reworked, and a lot of preparations under the hood for further updates of the game, so stay tuned for more!

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]

[list]
[*] Removed the lobby platform and replaced it with an intermission camera
[/list]

[h2]Audience Platforms[/h2]

[list]
[*] Gave the audience a new fresh look
[*] Updated the levels to fit with the new audience platforms
[*] Everest changed from daytime to nighttime
[*] Rumble Rafts got some new more optimized water
[*] Changed out the loading screens to show the updated levels
[*] General levels optimizations
[/list]

notes.title: 0.19.0 - Curveball
notes.content:
[h1]Hey everyone![/h1]

Here comes the patch for the upcoming playtest weekend!

We've made some impactful changes that should add more freedom and depth to the gameplay. We’re excited to hear your feedback!

[h2]UPDATED ABILITY[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]Dash[/b]
[list]
[*] Now has [b]3 charges[/b].
[*] If a player [b]deflects while dashing[/b], the ball will curve in the direction of the dash.
[/list]
[/list]

[h2]NEW MECHANIC[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]Ball curving[/b]
[list]
[*] Players can now [b]curve the ball[/b] by deflecting while dashing:
[list]
[*] [b]Dash left[/b] → Ball curves left
[*] [b]Dash right[/b] → Ball curves right
[*] [b]Dash forward[/b] → Deflects harder forward
[*] [b]Dash backward[/b] → Temporarily slows down the ball
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]

[i]Dev note: The ball will still target the player you’re looking at, but if you dash left while deflecting, it will curve left toward your target.[/i]  
[i]Dev note 2: This is our first iteration of ball curving. We have more ideas for refining the mechanic, but we’d love your feedback before making further changes! [THANKS EMOTE][/i]

[h2]VFX[/h2]

[list]
[*] New kill markers added:
[list]
[*] Gravestone
[*] Flower
[*] Trash Can
[/list]
[/list]

[i]Dev note: These kill markers are tied to [b]player level progression[/b] and can be unlocked by playing.[/i]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where players [b]retained velocity from the lobby[/b] when spawning into the arena.
[*] Fixed an issue with the [b]sprint animation[/b].
[*] Fixed a bug where [b]Mega Jump VFX[/b] could spawn multiple times.
[*] Fixed some sound issues related to sudden death.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.18.0 - Vissko and Everest
notes.content:
[h1]Hey everyone![/h1]

Here comes the patch for the upcoming playtest weekend!

The playtest will have specific time slots—check in-game or join our Discord to see when you can play!

[h2]Characters[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]New Character:[/b] [i]Viskko[/i]
[/list]

[h2]Levels[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]New Arena:[/b] [i]Everest[/i]
[/list]

[h2]Ball[/h2]

[list]
[*] Improved how the ball syncs between server and client. It should now feel more consistent when flying and orbiting players.
[/list]

[h2]Deflect[/h2]

[list]
[*] Players within [b]5m[/b] of someone using [i]Deflect[/i] will now be pushed away. This change helps prevent players from stacking on top of each other.
[/list]

[h2]Yoyo[/h2]

[list]
[*] The ball will now curve back toward the player who used the ability instead of instantly changing direction.
[/list]

[b]Dev Note:[/b] [i]We've noticed that [i]Yoyo[/i] is a bit too strong in its current state. This tweak makes it require more skill to time correctly, as the ball now curves back rather than snapping instantly. We'll monitor this change and make further adjustments if needed.[/i]

[h2]Kill Effects[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]New Feature (Testing Phase):[/b] Kill effects now play at the location where a player is eliminated.
[*] [b]Gravestone Kill Effect[/b] has been implemented as the default for testing.
[/list]

[b]Dev Note:[/b] [i]Kill effects will be customizable in the future, with new ones available to unlock or purchase. For now, we’ve added one for testing—more to come![/i]

[h2]VFX[/h2]

[list]
[*] Reworked [b]Mega Jump[/b] effect.
[*] Updated [b]Jump[/b] and [b]Double Jump[/b] VFX.
[*] Updated [b]Dash[/b] VFX.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where killboxes (falling off the arena) were not launching players correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could be spam-hacked.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that allowed throwable spam.
[*] Fixed an issue with ball pathfinding where it didn't account for the ball's size.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.17.2 - Next Fest Hotfix 2
notes.content:
[h1]Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]EXCLUSIVE player profile icon! “Next Fest 2025 DEMO”[/b]  
    This icon will be granted to all players who launch the game after this patch. Access to the icon will be removed once the demo ends, so don’t miss out!
[*] [b]Input Rebind Settings (WORK IN PROGRESS)[/b]  
    [b]Dev note:[/b] [i]We've added a very early [b]BETA version[/b] of the [b]input rebind[/b] page. It has several issues and may break, but we want as many players as possible to enjoy the final weekend of the demo. If you encounter any problems, press [b][RESET TO DEFAULTS][/b] on the input rebind page![/i]
[*] [b]Added Easy Anti-Cheat[/b] to improve security and prevent unfair play.
[*] [b]Adjusted round timer reduction on player death:[/b] 20s → 10s  
    [b]Dev note:[/b] [i]We read your feedback and agree that sudden death is being triggered too quickly, especially in full 6-player matches. This change should help rounds last a bit longer before sudden death kicks in.[/i]
[*] [b]Improved in-game clarity about match structure:[/b]  
    [list]
    [*] [b]Displaying "Round X"[/b] at the start of each round before the timer begins.
    [*] Added round progress indicators under the timer at the top of the screen.  
    [b]Dev note:[/b] [i]This is still a work-in-progress, and we’ll be refining it in future updates![/i]
    [*] Added an extra confirmation pop-up when attempting to exit back to the main menu.
    [/list]
[*] [b]Introduced a "Waiting for Players" stage[/b] during the loading screen when entering a server.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where bots and players could escape [b]Rumble Rafts Arena[/b] and go under the water.
[*] Fixed an issue where the four center rafts in [b]Rumble Rafts[/b] wouldn't appear correctly for clients after a round started on high-latency servers.
[*] Fixed an issue where the [b]cat head[/b] would remain stuck on players after being hacked.
[*] Fixed an issue where the ball would incorrectly lock onto a player during the sudden death timer if they used the yo-yo just before sudden death began.
[/list]

Let us know what you think of these changes, and as always, thanks for playing!

notes.title: Patch 0.17.1 - Next Fest Hotfix
notes.content:
[h1]Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Bots will now fill empty slots in servers and replace players who leave mid-match.
[/list]

[b]Dev Note:[/b] [i]We're testing this feature to ensure a smoother experience when players drop out. Our goal is to keep matches balanced and engaging for those who want to play through to the end. Let us know what you think![/i]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused character movement to stutter.
[*] Fixed a bug where weapons would sometimes float in the air.
[*] Adjusted bot AI—turns out they were [i]a little[/i] too smart. They should behave more appropriately now!
[*] Fixed a sound bug that caused ability audio (such as bomb or jump pad placement) to spam for all players when placed out of bounds.
[*] Resolved an overlapping UI issue in the main menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.14.0 - “Sudden Death”
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Everyone![/h1]

We’ve just released a new patch, bringing more polish and improvements! This update expands on the sudden death mechanic and enhances the overall game flow leading into sudden death. Check it out and let us know what you think!

[h2]Change log:[/h2]

[h3]Sudden Death[/h3]

[i]We’re continuing to improve the sudden death flow. We’re currently testing a full match reset where players are moved back to their original spawn points. This gives us a chance to showcase sudden death effects while giving players a moment to understand the situation and catch their breath.[/i]

[b]Sudden Death General[/b]
[list]
[*] Sudden death now resets the ball and triggers a new 3-second countdown.
[/list]

[b]Sudden Death Mechanic[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Short Deflect[/b]  
    [list]
    [*] A sudden death effect that shortens deflect duration, making it harder for players to time their deflects.
    [/list]
[/list]

[h3]Localization[/h3]

[i]We’ve started working on localization! This is a WIP, and we’ll continue to add support for more languages as we move forward.[/i]

[list]
[*] Added a language option in settings:  
    [list]
    [*] Settings > Gameplay > Language
    [/list]
[/list]

[h3]Ball[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added an outline to the ball to make it even clearer when it’s targeting the player.
[*] Added a ground decal under the ball to help players track its position when it’s high above them.
[/list]

[h3]Ability[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Place Jump Pad[/b]  
    [list]
    [*] Increased jump pad lifetime from 6s to 12s.
    [*] Increased jump pad launch force from 3000 to 4500.
    [/list]
[*] [b]Videos[/b]  
    [list]
    [*] Updated explanation videos for all abilities.
    [/list]
[/list]

[h3]Friend List and Party[/h3]

[list]
[*] Friend list is now sorted by online status, then by name.
[*] Added “Invite to Party” option in the friends menu dropdown.
[*] New popup for friend requests.
[/list]

[h3]VFX[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Updated Visuals for Abilities[/b]  
    [list]
    [*] Speed Boost
    [*] Power Boost
    [/list]
[/list]

[h3]Bugs[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the decal shadow under the player not displaying correctly on platforms in Rumble Rafts.
[*] Fixed formatting issues with “Time in Queue” and “Estimated Time in Queue.”
[*] Fixed an issue with player introductions where the wrong player level was displayed.
[/list]
